title: Demonstration Process Launched From Synthetic Staging Path
detection_hypothesis: If tooling is staged in a directory no managed installer writes to, the resulting process creation event shows an Image path rooted in that staging directory rather than in a managed installation directory.
unmapped_defensive_objects_reason: No Detection Strategy, Analytic, or Data Component identifier for this technique was present in the pinned ATT&CK extraction used by this lab.
author: Salvatore Mazzaglia
tuning_guidance: Prefer per-binary exclusions anchored on Image endswith. Do not exclude the whole staging directory, which would remove the rule's detection value.
